calculation.description: Measures directional 20-trading-day movement relative to the absolute-return path length. Positive values identify efficient, persistent upward trends; the one-day lag prevents same-close look-ahead.

validation.regime_notes: Daily cross-sectional Spearman IC across all available 15 tradable benchmark assets. Regime ICIR: 2020-22 1.1451 (753 observations), 2023-24 0.1892 (516), 2025-26 1.7331 (424). The small cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation; the factor is strongest at 10-20 day horizons and weaker in 2023-24.
